notes: TCATBALF: CardDemo's tcatbal.txt keys (the 50 account / type / category rows) with balances rewritten so the interest arithmetic is exercised -- the corpus ships every balance as zero. The first eight are S9(09)V99's extremes and truncation edges (+-999999999.99, +-0.01, 0, 11.99 / 12.01 / -12.01 around a monthly rate's cent), the rest spread over -50000.00..199999.99. Every other input is the corpus's own data. Derived from CardDemo (Apache-2.0; Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates): LICENSE and NOTICE here are the source's own.
